agent.name: Job radar
agent.line: Reads 76 company job boards every other day and tells you which new-grad roles are worth applying to.

families: GTM engineering / growth engineering / RevOps automation / AI GTM
Solutions engineering / forward-deployed engineering / AI deployment
wants: AI-native or AI-forward companies, where building agents is the job and not a side project
Early-career or new-grad friendly; real ownership
Locations: New York City or Boston/Cambridge preferred; other US cities and US-remote acceptable
dealbreakers: Pure quota-carrying sales (AE) with no building
Senior / staff / principal / manager / director titles

filters.plain: Title isn't a target role, or is senior, lead or intern

lessons.problem: A London job passed as US remote. A recruiter role scored 5 for saying “GTM”.
lessons.fix: “Remote” must name a US place. Recruiting, legal and sales roles are screened out.

lessons.problem: Most of the 630 asked for 3+ years, and each would cost a Claude call.
lessons.fix: Code reads “N+ years” from the posting for free and drops them.

lessons.problem: Contract roles and roles paying under $100k got through.
lessons.fix: Full-time only. Pay converted to yearly USD, $100k floor.

lessons.problem: No place to act on what it found.
Removing a role taught it nothing.
lessons.fix: Each removal can carry a reason that points at the rule to change.

lessons.problem: New roles were buried under old ones.
lessons.fix: A New section for the last 4 days.

lessons.problem: Opus costs 39× more per role than Haiku.
Keyword rules rated dozens of roles a 5.
lessons.fix: Claude re-read the top 60, quoting the posting as proof.

lessons.problem: No way to know which jobs it never saw.
lessons.fix: Log roles you find yourself; each is matched against everything it saw.
